visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman dressed in an ornate pink and white ancient Chinese Hanfu stands on a wooden bridge in a traditional garden. She holds a paper scroll, looking at it like a smartphone screen. The background features a green pavilion and lush trees. (2) Close-up on the scroll showing a black ink drawing of an older man. Her hands hold the paper edges firmly. (3) The woman makes a disgusted face, rolling her eyes and flicking her right hand to the side in a "swipe" motion. (4) She looks at a second scroll, then a third, each time reacting with dissatisfaction—either a bored look or a skeptical squint—before swiping them away. (5) A brief cutaway shows a line of pigeons perched on a railing, staring blankly at the camera. (6) The woman suddenly brightens up, her eyes widening and a smile forming as she looks at a new scroll. (7) Close-up of the scroll showing a young, handsome man with a topknot and yellow-trimmed white robes. (8) She squeals with delight, hugging the scroll to her chest and looking up with a dreamy expression. (9) The scene shifts to a vibrant night festival. Large red and white structures with branding are illuminated against a dark blue sky. She runs toward a booth. (10) She stands next to a life-size cardboard cutout of the handsome man, blushing and laughing while looking at him. (11) A final screen displays white text on a dark background with branding logos.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long black hair styled in a traditional bun with floral hairpins. She wears a layered Hanfu with floral embroidery and a sheer white outer robe.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The first half is set in a traditional Chinese garden with a green-roofed pavilion, stone bridges, and manicured shrubs. The second half is a night festival (Lantern Festival) with large neon signs, wooden booths, and decorative lanterns.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An upbeat, high-tempo BGM with a mix of modern electronic beats and traditional Chinese string instruments (Pipa) begins. A young woman's voice speaks with a clear, rhythmic cadence, sounding critical as she reviews profiles. (2) A sharp "whoosh" sound effect triggers as she simulates swiping, cutting through the music momentarily. Her vocal pitch is high, conveying a casual, modern attitude. (3) The vocal intensity increases as she expresses more annoyance. Each swipe is punctuated by the same high-frequency "whoosh" SFX. (4) A rapid sequence of three "whoosh" sounds occurs. Her voice rises in pitch with an inquisitive tone. (5) Her voice suddenly transitions into a high-pitched, excited exclamation with high arousal. The BGM gains a more festive layer with additional percussion. (6) The acoustic texture shifts slightly with a festive swell. The music volume remains dominant over faint outdoor ambience. (7) Final segment features the music maintaining its energy until a sharp cut-off at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Comedic Rejection -> Selection -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous 'POV' concept of an ancient person using a dating app (swiping through scrolls) to promote the Netflix show '五福臨門' and its physical exhibition at the New Taipei City Lantern Festival. The goal is to drive viewership and attendance at the event.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the show title, presence of Netflix logo, and a final CTA screen providing dates and location for a specific exhibition area.
